inbox.subject: RFP | Leadership offsite | 24 guests | 10–13 March 2027
inbox.body: Hello Group Sales, please quote 12 twin rooms for 24 employees arriving 10 March and departing 13 March 2027, with breakfast each morning. We need a private meeting room for 24 people on 11 March, 09:00–17:00, with projector, microphone and Wi-Fi. Our accommodation target is £250 per room/night including breakfast, and our total budget is £10,000. The company pays the package; guests cover incidentals. Please itemize the offer and include deposit, cancellation, attrition and rooming-list deadlines. Reply by 12 January at noon London time. Thanks, Maya, People Operations.

inbox.subject: RFP | Sales visit | Eight rooms | 10–13 March 2027
inbox.body: Please quote eight single-occupancy king rooms for eight employees arriving 10 March and departing 13 March 2027, with breakfast each morning. No meeting room is needed. We are targeting around £200 per room/night including breakfast, with a firm £5,000 total budget inclusive of taxes/fees. One corporate master bill; guests cover incidentals. A 30% deposit and standard terms are acceptable. Please reply by 13 January at noon London time. Alex, Events, Summit Robotics Demo Ltd.
